description: Protocol-agnostic feature tier shared by every per-protocol feature schema. Embedded as the leading block of each <log-type>-feature-schema-v1. Order is frozen; a change creates common-feature-tier-v2.

features.name: record_count_5m
features.description: Records seen for this (sensor, sourceIp) key in the 5-minute rolling window.

features.name: byte_sum_5m
features.description: Byte total for this key in the 5-minute rolling window.

features.name: failed_count_5m
features.description: Failed records for this key in the 5-minute rolling window.

features.name: inter_arrival_mean_ms
features.description: Running mean interval between records for this key, in milliseconds.

features.name: inter_arrival_stddev_ms
features.description: Running population standard deviation of the inter-arrival interval, in milliseconds.

features.name: is_orig
features.description: 1 if the record was sent by the connection originator, else 0.

features.name: conn_orig_bytes
features.description: Originator bytes since the previous conn.log snapshot. 0 when no snapshot is available.

features.name: conn_resp_bytes
features.description: Responder bytes since the previous conn.log snapshot. 0 when no snapshot is available.

features.name: conn_orig_pkts
features.description: Originator packets since the previous conn.log snapshot. 0 when no snapshot is available.

features.name: conn_resp_pkts
features.description: Responder packets since the previous conn.log snapshot. 0 when no snapshot is available.

features.name: conn_age_seconds
features.description: Connection age at the time of the latest conn.log snapshot, in seconds. 0 when no snapshot is available.

features.name: conn_enrichment_present
features.description: 1 if a conn.log snapshot was available for this record, else 0. Distinguishes a genuinely idle connection from one whose first snapshot has not yet been emitted.
